title: WatchlistRemovedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'watchlist.removed'. Phosphor Wave 2 lane L3: emitted when a user removes an item from their watchlist (DELETE /watchlist/{itemId}) and a row was actually deleted (a no-op remove of an item never watchlisted emits nothing — see packages/db/src/query/watchlist.ts's removeFromWatchlistAndEmit), in the SAME transaction as the delete. USER-SCOPED delivery — see watchlist.added.schema.json's description; the same rules apply here (packages/db/src/query/events.ts's USER_ONLY_TYPES).
